Name: Pet Bowl Recolor
Author: Minothilos
Description: A slight recolor of the new 1.6 asset Pet Bowl to better fit some recolor mods until they have been properly updated. Made with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]Medieval buildings[/url] in mind but should still fit better than the vanilla assets when using most toned down recolors. VPR can be played in 1.6 thanks to the temporary fix provided in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20698](CP) Vibrant Pastoral Recolor Temporary fix for 1.6[/url] but the bright yellow Pet Bowl really bothered me so I made this addition.
